name: claude-statusline-mirror
description: Shows the Claude Code status line in the VS Code status bar

claudeStatusline.file.description: Path to the mirrored status line file. Empty means ~/.claude/statusline.txt

claudeStatusline.staleMinutes.description: Dim the status bar entry once the data is older than this many minutes.

claudeStatusline.alignment.description: Which side of the status bar to use (reload required).
